## Overview

*[Placeholder — full project description to be written.]*

The semester-long applied project is completed in partnership with the **[Northern Border Regional Commission (NBRC)](https://www.nbrc.gov)**, a federal-state economic and community development commission serving rural northern Maine, New Hampshire, New York, and Vermont.

Students work in small teams. Each team analyzes a different **domain area** across the full NBRC four-state territory (rather than each team covering a different state). All teams use a consistent structure so outputs are comparable and can be assembled into a unified product for NBRC.
